name: fuseduo
author: Hollowbit Studio
description: Fuseduo: drag one app onto another and Claude builds a real automation.

scripts.test: node --test test/ && node scripts/ui-test.cjs dark && node scripts/refine-test.cjs && node scripts/quick-test.cjs && node scripts/app-test.cjs && node scripts/overflow-test.cjs && node scripts/share-test.cjs
scripts.dist: electron-builder --mac dmg:arm64 --publish never && electron-builder --mac dmg:x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Fuseduo runs the automations you approve, which control the apps you fused (for example Notes or Calendar).
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Some fusions save new files to a Fusions folder on your Desktop.
